title: Measure accuracy
summary: Accuracy is the fraction of labels predicted correctly. It can be misleading when one class is much more common than another.
introduction: Accuracy is the fraction of labels predicted correctly. It can be misleading when one class is much more common than another. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Accuracy is the fraction of labels predicted correctly. It can be misleading when one class is much more common than another.
The result is 0.75 because three of four predictions match.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find which prediction is wrong by comparing positions.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not rely only on accuracy for rare but important outcomes.
For more detail later, use this [Scikit-learn further reading](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/getting_started.html).
